title: Codefall review findings
description: One review of one target: what was reviewed, at which revision, who reviewed it, what was found, and what was decided about each finding. Written to .codefall/reviews/<timestamp>-<target-key>.json and rewritten after triage and after the fixes. A reviewer — subagent or external harness — returns this shape with every finding open; the session that triages fills in the rest.

key.description: The suffix of the filename stem, slugged: pr-51-init-below-root, SPEC-004-trip-sharing, feat-bd-unz-stage-context, range-a1b2c3d-e4f5a6b, src-fulfillment, adhoc, uncommitted.

ref.description: What the user typed, before resolution. For a prose target this is the description itself.

revision.description: The state reviewed, and the target's own rather than the session's: branch tip for a branch, headRefOid for a pull request, the to commit for a range, the last commit that touched a document, HEAD otherwise.

dirty.description: Short hash of the working-tree diff, present only when the tree was not clean. Distinguishes two reviews at one revision with different uncommitted changes.

base.description: For a branch, the merge-base with the default branch. For a pull request, baseRefOid. For a range, its from commit.

files.description: For a path or prose target, the files the review actually covered, as confirmed by the user.

upstream.description: Path of the document this target was checked against. Absent for code targets and for a vision.

name.description: The configured agent that answered, from the agents list in .codefall/settings.json. Absent for a raw via= form, for this session, and for the unconfigured default.

harness.description: subagent, session, or the external CLI that ran: claude, codex, muse, opencode, agy, gemini.

tried.description: The agents walked before the one that answered, in order, with why each did not: skipped when not runnable on this machine, failed when it ran and returned nothing usable.

reason.description: The exit code's meaning, or the harness's own words.

lenses.description: The lenses that ran, after anything dropped at the confirmation.

notChecked.description: What could not be reviewed, and why: no design behind the branch, no vision above the spec, a lens dropped at the confirmation.

heading.description: For a document target, the section the finding sits in.

claim.description: What is wrong, in one sentence.

conditions.description: When it manifests. Absent means always.

patch.description: A proposed diff in unified format. A starting point for the fix, not a script.

status.description: open when the reviewer writes it. Triage replaces it, and no finding is still open when an invocation ends normally.

reason.description: Why the user dismissed or deferred it. Required for dismissed.

bead.description: The design-revision bead filed for a deferred finding the design caused, when the user took the offer.

consult.description: Present when the finding was promoted from notChecked after a consult: the agent's name and one sentence of what it found. The session verified the cited lines before promoting; the consult never sets a status.

lens.description: One review pass. Closed rather than free text: a reviewer writing "behavior" where the skill says "behaviour" would otherwise validate, and the two would count as different lenses when the findings are merged.
